correctness.rationale: For a product of finite fields, if every coordinate projection of a total dominating set is proper, choosing each coordinate outside the negative projection produces a vertex adjacent to no selected vertex. Thus total and paired domination require at least the smallest field order, and paired domination additionally requires even cardinality. The canonical smallest-coordinate fiber induces a clique and totally dominates; it has a perfect matching in even order, and one explicit additional vertex resolves odd parity.
